# Learn Analytics Engineering (Substack)

> > A collection of resources covering TV entertainment guides, viral internet culture, and mobile app tutorials across platforms like TV Guide, Know Your Meme, and YouTube.

This site aggregates content from TV Guide (streaming recommendations and local listings), Know Your Meme (viral TikTok trends and internet culture), and YouTube Help documentation (Android app guides). The content spans entertainment discovery, meme culture analysis, and mobile platform tutorials.

## Key Topics

- TV Guide
- Know Your Meme
- TikTok trends
- YouTube mobile apps
- Netflix streaming
- TV schedules and listings
- Viral memes and catchphrases
- Entertainment news
- Android app installation
- Streaming services
- Local broadcast schedules
- Mobile app navigation
- Internet culture
- Celebrity news

## TV Guide & Streaming Services

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): Homepage with streaming recommendations, reviews & entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV schedule and listings finder by provider
- [Live Sports On TV Today - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/sports/live-today): Today's live sports schedule across MLB, NBA, NHL, UEFA & more
- [What to Watch on Netflix - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/streaming/netflix): Netflix catalog browser with filters for movies, shows & genres

## YouTube Mobile App Support

- [Find your way around YouTube - Android - YouTube Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/2398242): Navigation guide for YouTube Android app interface and features
- [Download the YouTube mobile app - Android - YouTube Help](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/3227660): Guide to downloading YouTube app on Android via Play Store

- [We Still Talk About You | Know Your Meme](https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/we-still-talk-about-you): Exploitable meme featuring heartbreaking cat/kitten art from DeviantArt
